rules.statement: A cause of action for the same debt cannot be pursued separately if it was part of a previous claim that was dismissed with costs.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now 'cause of action' is defined under section 5 of the Civil Procedure Code as 'the wrong for the prevention or redress of which an action may be brought,' and as including 'the denial to a right, the refusal to fulfil an obligation, the neglect to perform a duty, and the infliction of an affirmative injury.' I think that the word 'obligation' in this definition is to be understood not in the narrower sense in which a parol promise to pay a promissory note and a mortgage, although given for the same debt, may be described as three different 'obligations,' but in the more generally understood sense of a liability to pay that sum of money."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 5 of the Civil Procedure Code
